column7: Mass in the currently displayed unit.
Bit set shows the unit now displayed.
column15: bit 0 = gram [g]; bit 1 = kilogram [kg]; bit 2 = carat [ct]; bit 3 = pound [lb]; bit 4 = ounce [oz]; bit 5 = Newton [N]

bit 0 = Measurement correct (no error); bit 1 = Measurement stable; bit 2 = Indicating zero; bit 3 = Tared; bit 4 = In weighing range II; bit 5 = In weighing range III; bit 6 = NULL error; bit 7 = LH error; bit 8 = FULL error
0 = Process disabled; 1 = Dosing in progress; 2 = Process stopped; 3 = Process finished

column7: Bitmask of converter inputs; the 8 low bits are the inputs, bit 0 = input 1.

column15: 0 = Process finished correctly; 1 = Start mass / adjustment factor determination in progress; 2 = Range exceeded; 3 = Time exceeded; 4 = Process aborted; 5 = Awaiting data

column7: Set a bit to run that action once; clear it before repeating.
column15: bit 0 = Zero the platform; bit 1 = Tare the platform; bit 5 = Process start; bit 6 = Process stop; bit 8 = Start mass determination; bit 9 = Adjustment factor determination; bit 10 = Record adjustment parameters

column7: Set a bit to apply the matching parameter register below.
column15: bit 0 = Set tare value; bit 1 = Set LO threshold; bit 2 = Set outputs state; bit 3 = Set MIN threshold; bit 4 = Set MAX threshold; bit 5 = Set fast dosing threshold; bit 6 = Set precise dosing threshold; bit 9 = Set adjustment weight mass

column7: LO threshold to set, adjustment unit.
Output mask to apply, bit 0 = output 1.
